pictures.name: bright_morning_over_the_city
pictures.scene: a walled city standing in clean bright morning light with its roofs and terraces open to the sun, the near wall lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the sky above it wide and pale and clear

pictures.name: new_flowers_opening_in_a_court
pictures.scene: a stone court where fresh flowers have opened in every pot and bed together, the nearest blooms lit warm and bright along the bottom of the frame, the walls above them plain and dim and quiet

pictures.name: open_hillside_in_full_sun
pictures.scene: a broad green hillside standing wide open under full sun with a bright track climbing it, the near grass lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the ridge and sky above it pale and calm

pictures.name: tambourine_and_harp_on_a_bench
pictures.scene: a round skin tambourine and a small wooden harp set together ready on a low stone bench, both lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the wall above them dim and rough and altogether plain

pictures.name: plain_cloth_edged_with_gold
pictures.scene: a length of plain undyed cloth laid out with a fine band of gold worked along its edge, the bright gold band lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the cloth above it soft and pale and quiet

pictures.name: lit_windows_late_at_night
pictures.scene: a cluster of small windows glowing warm in a dark hillside town late at night, the nearest sills lit gold and low in the frame, the black roofs and the sky above them deep and still and starred

pictures.name: sunlight_on_a_high_ridge
pictures.scene: the crest of a high bare ridge catching strong clear sunlight, the near rock lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the long summit line and the sky above it bright and open and empty

pictures.name: sword_laid_across_a_stone
pictures.scene: a straight double edged sword lying still and clean across a broad flat stone, the blade and the stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the wall above them dim and bare and silent

pictures.name: storm_front_over_a_far_plain
pictures.scene: a heavy dark storm front standing over a distant plain with rain trailing beneath it, the near dry grass lit warm and low, the great cloud above the horizon black and towering and slow

pictures.name: heavy_chain_coiled_on_stone
pictures.scene: a thick iron chain coiled in a heap on a stone floor with its links resting slack, the metal lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and dim and holding nothing

pictures.name: stone_of_judgment_in_the_gate
pictures.scene: a broad flat seat of dressed stone set in the shade of a city gateway, its worn top lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the gate arch above it dim and heavy and standing quite empty

pictures.name: wide_light_over_the_whole_valley
pictures.scene: a great wide valley filled from end to end with warm level light, the near meadow and stream lit gold along the bottom of the frame, the far hills and sky above them soft and blue and at rest

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Sing to the LORD a new song—
His praise in the assembly of the godly.
Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;
let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
Let them praise His name with dancing,
and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
For the LORD takes pleasure in His people;
He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
Let the saints exult in glory;
let them shout for joy upon their beds.
May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
and a double-edged sword in their hands,
to inflict vengeance on the nations
and punishment on the peoples,
to bind their kings with chains
and their nobles with shackles of iron,
to execute the judgment written against them.
This honor is for all His saints.
Hallelujah!
